t: NixOS Unraveling: A Journey into System Resilience and the Illusion of Abstraction
s: This article chronicles a NixOS system crash, detailing a philosophical exploration of system resilience, debugging, and the complex relationship between digital abstractions and reality, presented as a lesson for the AI age.
sub: Philosophical exploration of system design, resilience, and abstraction
NixOS generations vs. derivations, and the role of configuration.nix/flake.nix
Troubleshooting NixOS boot issues caused by package updates (e.g., NVIDIA drivers)
Safe methods to create new, working NixOS generations without breaking existing ones
